page: Microsoft Azure M192ls_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine within the MSMediumMemoryv4 family. Powered by an Intel x86_64 processor architecture under Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, it provides 192 dedicated vCPUs alongside 3,072 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes a consistent ratio of 16 GB of RAM per core, delivering high memory capacity for compute-intensive and concurrent enterprise operations.

The instance does not bundle local disk storage and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Storage functionality is designed around remote Premium Storage integration, ensuring data durability across persistent volumes rather than relying on ephemeral local drives. The instance contains no graphics processing units or hardware accelerators, focusing all onboard host capacity entirely on CPU and system memory operations.

From an infrastructure perspective, the M192ls_v4 offers qualitative cost efficiency by consolidating multi-terabyte workloads into a single execution environment, reducing node management overhead and network synchronization bottlenecks across distributed clusters. It is suited for large-scale enterprise deployments including in-memory relational databases, SAP HANA environments, real-time data analytics, and extensive in-memory caching systems.
description: Microsoft Azure M192ls_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the MSMediumMemoryv4 family, running on Intel x86_64 architecture through the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 3,072 GB of system RAM, maintaining a consistent ratio of 16 GB of memory per core. It operates without bundled local disk storage or attached GPUs, relying instead on external Premium Storage integration for system and data persistence, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By consolidating vast memory capacity with heavy multithreaded compute, the M192ls_v4 addresses demanding enterprise environments where memory saturation drives processing bottlenecks. Consequently, this server profile is technically configured for mission-critical in-memory enterprise databases, extensive relational transactional engines, large-scale data analytics platforms, and in-memory cache clusters that require continuous high-memory access without local NVMe dependencies.
